stories.title: Bain predicts $6.5 trillion in AI data center spending by 2030
stories.summary: Global spending on data centers powering AI could reach $6.5 trillion by 2030, according to Bain & Company. The investment would nearly triple global computing capacity. The report notes that shortages of electricity, chips, and skilled workers could potentially slow the buildout.

stories.title: McKinsey values global wellness market at $2.7 trillion
stories.summary: McKinsey's 2027 Future of Wellness report values the global wellness market at $2.7 trillion. The research highlights recovery, biohacking, and consumer diagnostics as primary growth drivers. Consumers are increasingly combining recovery practices with social experiences, such as social saunas and cold plunges.

stories.title: PwC survey finds 90% of Indian consumers use health apps
stories.summary: A PwC survey of 1,005 Indian consumers found that 90% use health apps or wearables. About 81% of respondents said they are willing to pay more for devices that provide data reviewed by healthcare professionals. The firm suggests businesses must now convert this digital engagement into health outcomes.

stories.title: Indian consumers track health metrics to improve wellness
stories.summary: PwC India reports that Indian consumers are increasingly prioritizing longevity and stress reduction through digital tools and wellness interventions. Nearly 53 percent of surveyed consumers track protein intake, while 50 percent monitor fibre and 49 percent track calories. Wellness is now a data-driven everyday choice.

stories.title: PwC report finds 90 percent of Indians use health apps
stories.summary: PwC India's latest report suggests a structural shift in how the country approaches health, with 90 percent of consumers using wearables or health apps. The firm claims consumers are taking ownership of their health to achieve sustainable outcomes. The transition from reactive to proactive care continues.

stories.title: PwC survey links wellness trends to consumer habits
stories.summary: PwC's annual Voice of the Consumer report explores how Indian shoppers connect food and wellness. The company states that consumers are taking ownership of their health through digital tools and trusted food sources. The survey assessed 21,808 consumers across 27 global markets to reach these conclusions.

stories.title: Healthcare administrators struggle to measure AI returns
stories.summary: Nearly two-thirds of healthcare administrators expect meaningful returns from AI within three years, with many dedicating up to 25 percent of IT budgets to the technology. However, only 40 percent report being able to clearly measure the return on their investments. Actual gains remain uneven.

stories.title: Workers report AI productivity gains despite flat profits
stories.summary: A McKinsey survey found that 80 percent of employees believe AI improves their productivity. Yet, only 37 percent of organizations can link the technology to positive impacts on earnings before interest and taxes. This gap between personal efficiency and bottom-line results remains unchanged from last year.

stories.title: McKinsey suggests banks could see 3x returns on AI agents
stories.summary: A McKinsey report estimates that banks integrating agentic AI could see a 2.9 times return on investment within three years. The firm suggests institutions must redesign entire business processes rather than automate individual tasks to capture benefits. The payback period is estimated at approximately 10 months.

stories.title: Tanabe Consulting Group acquires Actus
stories.summary: Japanese management consultancy Tanabe Consulting Group has acquired a majority stake in New York-based Actus Consulting Group. The firm specializes in human capital services for Japanese businesses in the United States. Actus has worked with more than 1,000 Japanese companies since its founding in 2002.

stories.summary: Marketing agency Purpose Brand has acquired research consultancy MassiveMinds. The acquisition integrates custom AI approaches into the agency's existing workflow to power creativity with data. MassiveMinds founder Patrick Palmer will join the firm as President and Chief Strategy Officer.

stories.title: DSG Chartered Accountants acquires Bespoke Tax Services
stories.summary: DSG Chartered Accountants has acquired Wirral-based Bespoke Tax Services to expand its wealth advisory and private client offerings. The tax consultancy was founded in 2017 and specializes in overseas tax planning and investigations. The firm previously advised entrepreneurs and high net worth individuals.

stories.title: Philippine businesses lag in AI adoption
stories.summary: Philippine businesses are two years behind the global AI maturity curve, according to a report by Boston Consulting Group and the Makati Business Club. While 54 percent of surveyed companies aim to reach the highest maturity category, none of the 35 large firms surveyed have yet achieved it.

stories.title: India music industry sees earnings gap
stories.summary: India's music industry generated an estimated 17,401 crore in 2025, with independent music accounting for 43 percent of digital consumption. Despite the growth, an EY report notes that while 85 percent of creators want to make a living from music, only 55 percent pursue it full-time.

stories.summary: India's music creator economy grew 45 percent to 17,400 crore in 2025, according to an EY report. Digital consumption platforms accounted for 52 percent of the total economic value, while music publishing and performance revenues rose to 1,125 crore from 628 crore in 2023.

stories.title: Ficci proposes 100 trillion credit for manufacturing
stories.summary: Ficci has urged the government to establish a development finance framework for manufacturing, estimating 100 trillion in incremental credit is needed over the next decade. The industry body also proposed a 12,000 crore production linked incentive for battery components to help raise manufacturing to 25 percent of GDP.

Digital platforms accounted for 52 percent of the value, while sound recording and publishing revenues reached a record 5,433 crore. Employment in the sector expanded by 50 percent.

stories.title: Solar PLI scheme attracts 64,873 crore
stories.summary: The Production Linked Incentive scheme for solar modules attracted 64,873 crore in investment by March 2026, according to NITI Aayog. The initiative, backed by a 24,000 crore government outlay, added 24 GW to India's solar manufacturing capacity, which now stands at nearly 116 GW.

stories.title: India music market reaches record revenues
stories.summary: India's music creator economy generated 17,400 crore in 2025, with digital platforms contributing 52 percent of the value. Sound recording and publishing revenues reached a record 5,433 crore, and music consumption hit nearly six trillion streams, strengthening India's position as a large music market.

stories.summary: Accenture India is issuing performance-linked bonuses of 8 percent to 26 percent to eligible employees in November 2026. The payouts occur while regular salary increments remain on hold. The company is currently using the rewards cycle to distinguish between fixed salary growth and performance-based incentives.

EY India opens registrations for sixth Board Effectiveness programme
stories.summary: EY India has announced the sixth cohort of its Executive Program on Board Effectiveness. The four-week course aims to equip directors with skills for navigating AI and cybersecurity oversight. The programme starts 19 November 2026 for those looking to strengthen their strategic judgment and financial oversight capabilities.

stories.title: Accenture freezes base pay in India while offering performance bonuses
stories.summary: Accenture has introduced performance-linked bonuses of up to 26 percent for top-performing employees in India for its November 2026 cycle. Base pay revisions and promotions remain largely on hold. The company is focusing on rewarding individual performance while limiting broader increases in fixed salary costs.

stories.title: S Dinesh Pathak appointed to global payroll leadership at Accenture
stories.summary: Accenture has appointed S Dinesh Pathak as global HR shared services lead. Pathak, who joined the company in July 2026, oversees payroll operations across the US, UK and Canada. He brings 20 years of experience in payroll management, automation and financial governance to the role.

stories.title: Priyank Sinha joins PwC Acceleration Center India as director
stories.summary: Priyank Sinha has joined PwC Acceleration Center India as a director in its tax innovation and delivery excellence division. Sinha moves from IG Group, where he focused on AI-powered engineering. His new role adds to a career spanning global delivery operations and digital transformation.

stories.title: Accenture India links November bonuses to performance
stories.summary: Accenture has announced performance-linked bonuses of up to 26 percent for top-performing employees in India for its November 2026 cycle. Regular salary increments and promotions remain limited. Payouts start at 8 percent for eligible staff, while those categorised as non-performers have been excluded from the rewards.
